label: Begun populated pasts from coinitial Grim Reaper pieces and patchwork
description: Non-transcription conditional support option for the begun version of A3 prime a, the faithful target of the Grim Reaper argument for a past with a beginning. Suppose a contingent concrete thing is present at t in an accessible history and the past of t has no beginning. Countable coinitiality gives a strictly descending sequence from t running below every earlier moment (one station per past day). The coinitial local premise makes adjacent pieces co-possible, coinitial patchwork glues them into one accessible world, and the same register-to-signal translation as in the founded argument meets IndexedSignalReaper.impossible. The coinitial premises are implied by the unrestricted ones and are silent about pasts with a beginning, so its premises are satisfiable together with a first moment followed by moments with no earliest one (control 3, on WithBot Int times). Under its premises it does exclude contingent presence in an open-below past such as the positive reals, which is order-theoretically beginningless though metrically finite; a metric restriction is untested. All three premises are OPEN. Nothing is attributed to Koons or Pruss. No premise is established.
